diagnoses.description: In the `analyze_image_to_json` example, the `except json.JSONDecodeError` handler references `response.choices[0].message.content`, but `response` may be undefined if the API call fails before assignment. This can raise an `UnboundLocalError`, masking the original failure and breaking the example’s error handling.

diagnoses.description: `check_fillable_fields.py` executes PDF reading at import time and does not validate CLI arguments. If run without an argument it will crash with `IndexError`, and importing the module will immediately attempt to open `sys.argv[1]` as a PDF (undesired side effect).
